import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int addModulo(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
        return a;
    }

    static int multiplyModulo(int a, int b) {
        long res = 1L * a * b;
        if (res >= MOD) res %= MOD;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] mat;
        int N, M;

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            N = n;
            M = m;
            mat = new int[N][M];
        }

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    mat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void makeIdentity() {
            reset();
            int limit = Math.min(N, M);
            for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
                mat[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix transpose() {
            Matrix t = new Matrix(M, N);
            t.reset();
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    t.mat[i][j] = mat[j][i];
                }
            }
            return t;
        }

        int[] getRow(int r) {
            return mat[r];
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(N, M);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] = addModulo(this.mat[i][j], other.mat[i][j]);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiplyBy(int scalar) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(N, M);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] = multiplyModulo(this.mat[i][j], scalar);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        static Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            int n = a.N;
            int m = b.M;
            int x = a.M; // same as b.N
            Matrix out = new Matrix(n, m);
            out.reset();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                    if (a.mat[i][j] != 0) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                            out.mat[i][k] = addModulo(out.mat[i][k], multiplyModulo(a.mat[i][j], b.mat[j][k]));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int K = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize arrays
        Matrix[][][] A = new Matrix[65][35][1]; // We will store only the necessary matrices
        Matrix[][][] S = new Matrix[65][35][1];
        Matrix[][][] P = new Matrix[65][35][1];

        // Since Java doesn't support variable-sized arrays of objects directly, we will use dynamic allocation
        // Initialize A[0][i]
        Matrix[][] A0 = new Matrix[35][1];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A0[i] = new Matrix(K, K);
            A0[i].makeIdentity();
            A0[i].mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        // For convenience, store A[0][i]
        Matrix[][][] A_matrices = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix[][][] S_matrices = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix[][][] P_matrices = new Matrix[65][35];

        // Initialize for i=0
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A_matrices[0][i] = A0[i];
        }

        long length = K;
        int iIndex = 1;
        while (length <= n) {
            // Initialize S[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                S_matrices[iIndex - 1][j] = new Matrix(K, K);
            }
            // Initialize P[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                P_matrices[iIndex - 1][j] = new Matrix(K, K);
            }

            // Compute S[i-1][K-1]
            S_matrices[iIndex - 1][K - 1] = A_matrices[iIndex - 1][K - 1];

            // Compute S[i-1][j]
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                S_matrices[iIndex - 1][j] = Matrix.multiply(A_matrices[iIndex - 1][j], S_matrices[iIndex - 1][j + 1]);
            }

            // Compute P[i-1][0]
            P_matrices[iIndex - 1][0] = A_matrices[iIndex - 1][0];

            // Compute P[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                P_matrices[iIndex - 1][j] = Matrix.multiply(P_matrices[iIndex - 1][j - 1], A_matrices[iIndex - 1][j]);
            }

            // Compute A[i][0]
            A_matrices[iIndex] = new Matrix[K][1];
            A_matrices[iIndex][0] = S_matrices[iIndex - 1][0];

            // Compute A[i][j]
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                A_matrices[iIndex][j] = Matrix.multiply(S_matrices[iIndex - 1][j], P_matrices[iIndex - 1][j - 1]);
            }

            length *= K;
            iIndex++;
        }

        // Convert n to base K digits
        int[] digits = new int[65];
        int lenDigits = 0;
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            digits[lenDigits++] = (int) (tempN % K);
            tempN /= K;
        }

        // Initialize result matrix
        Matrix result = new Matrix(K, K);
        result.makeIdentity();

        int s = 0;
        for (int idx = lenDigits - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            int digit = digits[idx];
            for (int j = 0; j < digit; j++) {
                result = Matrix.multiply(result, A_matrices[idx][(j + s) % K]);
            }
            s = (s + digit) % K;
        }

        int res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            res = addModulo(res, result.mat[i][K - 1]);
        }

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
